name: Meyers 200
summary: 1950s-60s Meyers four-seat retractable low-wing, admired for its clean lines and very strong airframe. Rights later passed to Aero Commander.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Main gear retracts into the wing
engines: Single Continental flat-six in a slim cowl
fuselage: Narrow four-seat enclosed cabin with clean lines
tail: Conventional single fin and rudder with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Slick four-seat low-wing with retractable tricycle gear and a conventional tail
Narrow, sleek fuselage with no struts and no fixed gear
Looks like a Bonanza without the V-tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The V-tail Bonanza is obvious from its V-tail; the Meyers has a conventional fin and horizontal tail.
The Comanche has a wider, rounder cabin and an all-moving stabilator; the Meyers is narrower and sleeker.
The Mooney has a forward-raked fin trailing edge and a smaller cabin; the Meyers has an upright conventional fin.
